js: (async () => { const s = await window.api.settings.get(); await window.api.settings.set({ llmProvider: 'custom', customBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:18777/v1', llmModels: { ...s.llmModels, custom: 'mock-model' } }); window.__prog = []; window.api.on.scriptProgress((e) => { window.__prog.push(e.from + '-' + e.to + '/' + e.total); });window.__klikKartu = (judul) => { const art = [...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find((a) => a.textContent.includes(judul)); if (!art) return false; const btn = art.querySelector('button'); if (!btn) return false; btn.click(); return true; }; window.__klikTombol = (teks) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === teks); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; }; window.__teksAda = (teks) => document.body.innerText.includes(teks); window.__isiDurasi = (v) => { const el = document.querySelector('#durasi-custom'); if (!el) return false; const s = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; s.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; console.log('UI-SETUP ok'); })()
